scripts.build: bun run db:generate && bun run --cwd apps/web build
scripts.typecheck: bun run db:generate && bun run types:generate && bun run --filter "*" typecheck
scripts.types:generate: bun run --cwd apps/jobs types:generate && bun run --cwd apps/web types:generate
scripts.test: bun run --cwd apps/jobs test && bun run --cwd apps/web test
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build
scripts.format: prettier --write apps packages package.json tsconfig.base.json .prettierrc.json .github/workflows/check.yml README.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check apps packages package.json tsconfig.base.json .prettierrc.json .github/workflows/check.yml README.md
scripts.setup: bun run db:generate && bun run types:generate && bun run db:migrate:local
